screens.name: Dashboard
screens.description: Main spending overview with current month breakdown, active goals progress, and streak counter.

componentTypes.name: AppHeader
componentTypes.description: Logo, app title 'Wavelength', user avatar menu, and notification icon

componentTypes.name: MainNavigation
componentTypes.description: Navigation links: Dashboard, Goals, Transactions, Settings. Active state indicator on current page.

componentTypes.name: StreakBanner
componentTypes.description: Prominent display of current spending streak (e.g., '12 days on budget') with flame icon and next milestone

componentTypes.name: MonthlyBudgetCard
componentTypes.description: Current month budget overview: total budget, spent amount, remaining, and circular progress ring with accent color

componentTypes.name: SpendingBreakdownChart
componentTypes.description: Horizontal bar chart or donut showing spending by category (Food, Transport, Entertainment, Shopping, Other) with category labels and percentages

componentTypes.name: ActiveGoalsList
componentTypes.description: Table of 4+ active savings goals: goal name, target amount, current savings, progress bar, and time remaining. Sortable by progress or deadline.

componentTypes.name: RecentTransactionsFeed
componentTypes.description: List of 5-6 most recent transactions: date, merchant, category icon, amount, and running balance. Link to full transaction history.

screens.name: Goals
screens.description: Savings goals management: create new goals, view all goals with progress, edit or delete existing goals.

componentTypes.name: AppHeader
componentTypes.description: Logo, app title, user avatar menu, notification icon

componentTypes.name: MainNavigation
componentTypes.description: Navigation links with active state on Goals

componentTypes.name: PageHeader
componentTypes.description: Page title 'Savings Goals' and 'Create Goal' button (primary accent color)

componentTypes.name: GoalsFilterBar
componentTypes.description: Filter tabs: All, Active, Completed. Shows count for each filter state.

componentTypes.name: GoalsTable
componentTypes.description: Table with 6+ goals: goal name, category icon, target amount, current savings, progress bar (accent color), deadline, and row actions menu (edit, delete, view details)

componentTypes.name: GoalDetailModal
componentTypes.description: Modal overlay for viewing/editing goal: name, target amount, current savings, deadline, category, description, and save/cancel buttons

componentTypes.name: GlobalSidebar
componentTypes.description: Fixed left sidebar (240-280px) on desktop. Contains Wavelength logo, main navigation (Dashboard, Goals, Transactions, Settings), and user profile section at bottom. Collapses to icon-only on smaller viewports.

componentTypes.name: GlobalTopbar
componentTypes.description: Fixed top navigation bar (56-64px) spanning full width. Contains app logo/title on left, notification bell icon, and user avatar dropdown on right. Visible on all app screens.
